meta.title: Vetudy | Online veterinary courses
meta.description: Online courses for veterinarians in Egypt.

home.title: Learn veterinary medicine from leading doctors
home.subtitle: Video courses taught by specialist veterinarians in Egypt, to watch any time and anywhere.

register.title: Sign up
register.description: Create your account to start learning.
register.successBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account, then log in.

verify.successBody: Your account is now active. You can log in.
verify.failedTitle: We could not verify your email
verify.failedBody: This link is invalid or was already used. If you already verified your email, you can log in.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for this email, a message with a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.missingBody: Open the link from the email again, or request a new one.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked for a while after too many wrong attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email first. Open the link we sent you.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you asked for.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email is already registered. Try logging in.
errors.LAST_SUPERADMIN: The last platform owner cannot be deleted or given another role.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.CATEGORY_TOO_DEEP: Categories have two levels only: a category and a subcategory.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: A category that has subcategories or courses cannot be deleted.
errors.COURSE_OWNER_INVALID: The course owner must be a doctor account.
errors.COURSE_INCOMPLETE: This course is not complete. Add a category, a thumbnail, and at least one lesson before sending it for review.
errors.COURSE_INVALID_STATE: This action is not possible in the course's current status.
errors.REVIEW_NOTE_REQUIRED: Write a note that explains the decision.
errors.SELF_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot change your own role or delete your own account. Ask another owner to do it.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

courses.title: Courses
courses.empty: There are no courses in this category yet.
courses.lessonCount: {count, plural, =0 {No lessons} one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}

account.title: My account
account.emailNote: The email address cannot be changed.

statusHelp.draft: Only you and the platform team can see this course. Send it for review when it is ready.
statusHelp.in_review: The platform team is reviewing this course. You can keep editing while you wait.
statusHelp.published: This course is live. Your edits appear to students as soon as you save.
statusHelp.archived: This course is hidden from the catalog. Enrolled students can still watch it.

actions.noteHelp: What should the doctor fix? They will see this note.

courses.title: Courses
courses.emptyHint: Create your first course to get started.
courses.archivedHint: Archived courses are hidden from students. Open one and choose Unarchive to put it back on sale.

course.priceHelp: Whole pounds. 0 makes the course free.
course.priceLocked: The price can be changed only while the course is a draft. Ask the platform team to change it.
course.thumbnailHelp: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Shown on the course card.
course.shareHelp: Leave as is to keep the platform default.
course.ownerChangeTitle: Move this course to another doctor?
course.ownerChangeBody: The course will belong to {to} instead of {from}. Future sales are credited to {to}. Past sales stay with {from}.
course.subcategoryHelp: Optional. Narrows where the course appears.

curriculum.title: Modules and lessons
curriculum.videoHelp: Paste the link you copied from YouTube. Only the video ID is saved.
curriculum.videoInvalid: That does not look like a YouTube link or video ID.
curriculum.freePreviewHelp: Anyone can watch this lesson without buying the course.
curriculum.noModules: No modules yet. A module is a chapter that groups lessons.
curriculum.noLessons: No lessons in this module yet.
curriculum.deleteModuleBody: The module and all of its lessons will be deleted.

categories.title: Categories
categories.help: Two levels: main categories and their subcategories.
categories.name: Name

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.newHelp: The account is created already verified, so the person can log in right away.
users.ownerWarning: Owners control everything, including other owners. Only give this role to someone you fully trust.
users.passwordConfirmHelp: Type your own password to confirm.
users.selfLocked: You cannot change your own role.
users.emailNotice: {name} and every owner will get an email about this change.
users.newOwnerHint: To make someone an owner, create them first, then change their role.
users.ownerEmailSent: Almost done. We emailed you a confirmation link. Open it while logged in and press Confirm to make {name} an owner. The link works for 30 minutes.
users.ownerTwoSteps: Making someone an owner takes two steps: your password now, then a confirmation link sent to your email.
users.confirmBody: {name} ({email}) will be able to do everything you can, including managing other owners. Everyone involved will get an email.
users.confirmInvalid: This link is invalid, has expired, or was already used. It also only works for the owner who asked for it. Start again from the users page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shareHelp: Copied onto each new course. Changing it does not affect existing courses.

statusHelpStaff.archived: This course is hidden from the catalog. Enrolled students can still watch it. Use Unarchive to put it back on sale.
